1. Claim 13 (Currently amended): A computer program product comprising: a __non-transitory__ computer readable storage medium; computer readable program code, stored on the __non-transitory__ computer readable storage medium, for __comparing a first user identifier against a plurality of existing user identifiers in a data source to determine whether the first user identifier contains character variants that match characters in any of the existing user identifiers according to a policy, wherein the policy defines which characters are considered variants of each other__; computer readable program code, stored on the __non-transitory__ computer readable storage medium, for rejecting the first user identifier responsive to a determination that the first user identifier contains __such character variants matching characters in an existing user identifier__ in the data source using the policy; computer readable program code, stored on the __non-transitory__ computer readable storage medium, for storing the first user identifier in the plurality of user identifiers responsive to an absence of a determination that the first user identifier contains __such character variants matching characters in an existing user identifier__ in the data source using the policy.

2. Claim 14 (Currently amended): The computer program product of claim 13, wherein the computer readable program code is stored in a __non-transitory__ computer readable storage medium in a data processing system, and wherein the computer readable program code is downloaded over a network from a remote data processing system.

3. Claim 15 (Currently amended): The computer program product of claim 13, wherein the computer readable program code is stored in a __non-transitory__ computer readable storage medium in a server data processing system, and wherein the computer readable program code is downloaded over a network from a remote data processing system for use in a __non-transitory__ computer readable storage medium with the remote system.

4. Claim 16 (Currently amended): The computer program product of claim 13, wherein the policy comprises a table of character variants, wherein the table of character variants comprises character variants for a plurality of characters __that may appear in user identifiers__.

5. Claim 17 (Previously presented): (Original)

6. Claim 18 (Currently amended): An apparatus comprising: a bus system; a storage device connected to the bus system, wherein the storage device includes program code; and a processor unit connected to the bus system, wherein the processing unit is configured to execute the program code to __compare a first user identifier against a plurality of existing user identifiers in a data source to determine whether the first user identifier contains character variants that match characters in any of the existing user identifiers according to a policy, wherein the policy defines which characters are considered variants of each other, responsive to receiving a request to store the first user identifier in the data source containing the plurality of user identifiers__, reject the first user identifier responsive to a determination that the first user identifier contains __such character variants matching characters in an existing user identifier__ in the data source using the policy, and store the first user identifier in the plurality of user identifiers responsive to an absence of a determination that the first user identifier contains __such character variants matching characters in an existing user identifier__ in the data source using the policy.

7. Claim 19 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 18, wherein the policy comprises a table of character variants, wherein the table of character variants comprises character variants for a plurality of characters __that may appear in user identifiers__.

8. Claim 20 (Previously presented): (Original)
